name: sira-hr
description: SIRA HR website: React + TypeScript + Tailwind front-end and Express + MongoDB API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
